اشرأببن (form IVq)
# اِشْرَأْبَبْنَ (išraʔbabna) /iʃ.raʔ.bab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِشْرَأَبَّ (išraʔabba)
# اِشْرَأْبِبْنَ (išraʔbibna) /iʃ.raʔ.bib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِشْرَأَبَّ (išraʔabba)
